title: "Sun Kissed" in Inlet Beach | Coast Property Management – Coast Properties
meta_description: "Sun Kissed" in Inlet Beach | Coast Property Management
description_expanded: Welcome to “Sun Kissed” - our luxury 4 Bedroom, 6 Bathroom beach home in Inlet Beach. LOCATION:  Located within the Inlet Heights neighborhood, this brand new beach home is the perfect gathering place for entertaining any group. The community pool is only 0.4 miles away and leads directly to the community’s dock access to Lake Powell for paddle boarding, kayaking, and other water sports. On the south, the home is just 1/2 mile from the closest public beach access point (Phillips Inlet), and has a total of four beach access points with 1.5 miles. You will be in close proximity to boutique, upscale shopping/dining at 30Avenue but also just a short drive to familiar grocery stores and other entertainment at Pier Park. The home is only a 20-minute drive from Panama City Airport. PROPERTY OVERVIEW: This exquisite home’s entryway leads guests past a half bathroom to the first floor common area, complete with indoor pool table, smart TV, full-size fridge/freezer, wet bar, and board games. There is ample seating for the entire group with a large sectional and additional tabletop seating. Stepping out to the back yard you will find an outdoor paradise - a ping pong table, large fire pit with seating, corn hole, and a putting green. The home is EV-friendly, and has a level 2 charger installed in the garage which is available for guest use. The the home’s second floor main dining area is comprised of a dining table with seating for six and additional seating for four at the breakfast bar. The open concept kitchen comes stacked with brand-new, premium fixtures, fittings, and appliances; a dual coffee maker, stainless steel fridge/freezer, oven, microwave, dishwasher, blender and all the cookware, bakeware and crockery you could need. There is plenty of cooking room on the five-burner gas range and full selection of cutlery and utensils for both adults and kids. The living room provides intimate seating and a large smart TV. Down the hall you will find the second floor master bedroom which comes with a king bed, mounted smart TV, spacious en suite with walk-in shower and a walk-in closet. The third floor is comprised of three bedrooms - A king room with a luxurious private en suite (bath and walk-in shower) and walk-in closet, a bunk room that sleeps up to eight people across four full beds, and a queen room with a full bathroom and closet. The third floor landing area also has a mini fridge and coffee station. The fourth floor roof access is the perfect way to soak in the pristine views of the gulf, as well as the area’s picture-perfect sunsets. The space boasts seating for six, as well as a large smart TV, drinks fridge, wet bar, and ice maker. AMENITIES: The home provides plenty of beach gear (chairs, umbrellas, beach games, a beach wagon, etc.) towels (including beach towels), fresh linens, a pack-n-play, cutlery, iron and ironing board, cooking utensils, and 2-car driveway. The home comes with a full TV streaming package to watch all your favorite shows and sporting events. The garage hosts a level 2 EV charger, four brand-new premium beach cruisers and can house a golf cart if one is rented.  We offer a starter supply of premium, eco-friendly guest amenities: Body Wash Shampoo Conditioner Hand Soap Toilet Paper Facial Tissues Dish Soap Dishwasher Pods Laundry Detergent Paper Towels Trash Bags Dish Sponge NOTE: The primary guest must be 25 or older to rent this home. This home has a strict no-pet policy. Unauthorized occupancy of pets will result in immediate eviction and loss of all rents and deposits, and the guest will be responsible for any and all direct consequential damages. Unless you have specifically arranged for an early arrival time, please do not arrive at the property before your scheduled check-in time. Do not hang towels on porch/balcony railings. The HOA imposes fines on guests found to be doing so. Quiet hours for this community are from 10PM to 8AM CT. Please be respectful of neighbors within the community. Persistent violations of noise ordinances may result in eviction. CONTACT: Need anything during your stay? Coast’s management team will assist you with anything you need. Just give us a call!
